name: Forward Farewell
source:
Even the average courier's day can be sprinkled with small miracles.

[Taken from [url=https://endpaper.itch.io/forwardfarewell]itch.io page[/url].]

Micro visual novel set in the universe of Upwards Rain, made for the O2A2 VN Jam 2026.
translation:
即使是普通快递员的一天，也可能点缀着小小的奇迹。

（摘自[url=https://endpaper.itch.io/forwardfarewell]itch.io页面[/url]）

一部与《Upwards Rain》设定在同一世界的微型视觉小说，为2026年O2A2视觉小说创作活动制作。
